name: We Will Meet Again
source:
"I often have strange dreams about a crybaby boy who only yearns for a promise I've forgotten."

You were an ordinary office worker until recently, when terrifying nightmares began haunting you relentlessly, causing constant mistakes at work. You got fired, and then, fate led you into the layers of the most surreal dream.

A dream you will never forget, until the day you cease to be.

+++++++++

This visual novel features three endings. Due to my laggy computer and my laziness, it's quite short with crude artwork - you could call it "The Worst Visual Novel You've Ever Played."

He in this story is nobody in your life, like wild grass sprouting naturally from soil - no one knows why it chose that particular patch of earth to grow.
translation:
“我经常做奇怪的梦，梦见一个爱哭鬼的男孩，他只渴望一个我已经忘记的承诺。”

你原本是一名普通的上班族，直到最近，可怕的噩梦开始无情地困扰着你，导致工作中不断出现错误。你被解雇了，然后，命运带领你进入了一层层最超现实的梦想。

一个你永远不会忘记的梦想，直到你不再存在的那一天。

+++++++++

这部视觉小说有三个结局。由于我的电脑迟缓和我的懒惰，它的画质很粗糙——你可以称它为“你玩过的最糟糕的视觉小说”。

这个故事中的他在你的生活中无足轻重，就像从土壤中自然发芽的野草一样——没有人知道它为什么选择那片土地来生长。
